description: Use this when the user has only a job posting (no resume yet) and wants its key skills and keywords. List the skills, tools and requirements a job posting asks for, ranked by how hard it leans on each (repetition, position, required or preferred headings), with the high-priority ones flagged. Use match_job to see which a resume already shows. Posting 120–20,000 characters. Rules version 2026-10-25.1.

job_description.description: The full job posting as plain text, including its requirements (120–20,000 characters). For a link, call fetch_job_post first.

name: keyword_scan
title: Rank a job post's keywords
